bias.en: Strong bullish · rejected at the December highs
bias.zh: 强势看多 · 在去年12月高点受阻

read.en: Zscaler fell 3.4% on Oct 12 to $225.78 after reaching $237.22 intraday, but is still up 12% in five sessions. It is above all its averages: 5-day ($220), 10-day ($210), 30-day ($195), 100-day ($165) and 200-day ($166), though the 200-day is still edging lower. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 7 with a growing histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 6, and RSI is 66.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月12日盘中触及 $237.22 后回落 3.4%，收于 $225.78，但五个交易日仍上涨 12%。股价位于全部均线上方：5 日（$220）、10 日（$210）、30 日（$195）、100 日（$165）和 200 日（$166），但 200 日均线仍小幅下行。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线上方且柱体放大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起看多，RSI 为 66。

read.en: The intraday push stalled at the December 2025 highs ($235–237). A close above $237 would target $250, then $280–293 (Aug–Sep 2025 highs). Support is $217–220 (5-day average, Oct 8 close), then the 10-day near $210 and $195 (30-day average and SAR).
read.zh: 盘中上冲在 2025年12月高点（$235–237）受阻。若收盘站上 $237，目标看 $250，再看 $280–293（2025年8–9月高点）。支撑为 $217–220（5 日均线、10月8日收盘价），其次约 $210 的 10 日均线和 $195（30 日均线及 SAR）。
